_comment: SkippyMCP target for the digital-stimulus E2E: Rigol MSO5204 at hostname 'dso1'. Raw-socket resource (single TCP port 5555, NAT/mirrored-friendly) -- preferred over VXI-11 '::INSTR' which negotiates a flaky secondary port. Pass to the driver/server with --config, or use the resource string directly with --resource.
